description: This file is a shell script that defines test functions and test cases for verifying the correctness of 'git check-ref-format'. It includes functions for testing valid and invalid reference names with various options, and executes a series of automated tests to check the behavior of 'git check-ref-format' under different conditions.

methods.name: valid_ref
methods.description: Defines a test case for a valid reference name, possibly with additional options, asserting that 'git check-ref-format' returns success.

methods.name: invalid_ref
methods.description: Defines a test case for an invalid reference name, possibly with additional options, asserting that 'git check-ref-format' fails.

methods.name: valid_ref_normalized
methods.description: Defines a test case that verifies the normalization of a reference name results in the expected output.

methods.name: invalid_ref_normalized
methods.description: Defines a test case that verifies normalization rejects certain invalid reference names.
